clue.text: Daisy has them surrounding the lead in Empire Strikes Back

indicators.note: the reversed word for strikes wraps round the leading letter, so it is placed outside it
Back tells us to read the word for strikes from right to left

parts.note: to strike someone with an open hand is to slap them

indicators.note: the lead in a word is its opening letter, here of Empire

explanation.surface: A nod to The Empire Strikes Back, with a daisy oddly wrapped round its opening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' turns SLAPS into SPALS, which goes round E, the first letter of 'Empire'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sepals are the small leaf-like parts under a flower's petals, and a daisy, like most flowers, has them.

clue.text: The Force Awakens? Except for him slowing you down

definitions.text: The Force Awakens? Except for him slowing you down

parts.words: The Force Awakens? Except for him slowing you down
parts.note: the police are 'the force', and the one member of it who has not woken up is a road hump that slows drivers

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a road hump that makes drivers slow down is named after a dozing constable, the one member of the force who does not awaken.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for a speed bump: a raised strip across the road that forces traffic to slow down.

clue.text: Father inches towards Luke, extremely shaken to begin with. "Son! It's easy!"

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
in is the abbreviation for inches

indicators.note: extremely asks for the letters at the extreme ends of Luke
to begin with picks out only the opening letter of shaken

parts.note: S is a standard abbreviation for son, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: Darth Vader edges towards a rattled Luke and reassures him the conversion will be easy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'towards' just joins the pieces; LE is the outside of 'Luke', S the start of 'shaken'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that causes no pain or trouble is effortless, hence simple to do.

clue.text: Reason Solo therefore got shot by Greedo in cantina firstly

indicators.note: got shot of means got rid of, so the word for therefore is removed from Solo

parts.note: so can mean therefore, as in 'so it follows'

indicators.note: firstly takes the opening letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: Han Solo's reasoning: he was shot at by Greedo in the Mos Eisley cantina, so he fired.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface shouts Han shoots Greedo, but 'got shot' here means 'got shot of': SO goes from 'Solo', leaving LO, then G, I and C start the next three words.
explanation.definitionFit: Logic is sound reasoning, the faculty of thinking things through in order.

clue.text: One is … one is in danger from the Empire…

parts.note: one is, said of oneself, contracts to I'm

indicators.note: is in tells us the letter for one sits inside the word for danger

parts.note: peril is a synonym of danger
a means one, as in 'a pound'

explanation.surface: A stammering warning: someone is in danger from the Galactic Empire.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'one is' tempts a single reading, but the first gives a contraction and the second 'one' is just the article.
explanation.definitionFit: Imperial is the adjective for anything belonging to or coming from an empire, like Star Wars' Imperial forces.

clue.text: Sci-fi villain's caught you and me in dreams

indicators.note: caught shows the villain's name holding the pronoun inside it

parts.note: Ming the Merciless is the villain of Flash Gordon; with the 's he gives MINGS
you and me together are us

explanation.surface: A science-fiction villain has captured the two of us in our dreams.
explanation.walkthrough: Ming the Merciless, Flash Gordon's foe, is a classic crossword villain.
explanation.definitionFit: Musings are idle reflections or daydreams, the wandering thoughts of someone lost in reverie.

clue.text: Happily see about latex moulded on dewback's head

indicators.note: about means round, so the bishop's seat goes round the rest

parts.note: a see is a bishop's diocese, and Ely in Cambridgeshire is the crossword's usual one

indicators.note: moulded says the letters are shaped into a new arrangement
head asks for the first letter of dewback's

explanation.surface: Cheerfully look at rubber shaped on the head of a dewback, the Tatooine riding lizard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moulded' turns LATEX plus D (the head of 'dewback's') into XALTED, which ELY goes 'about'.
explanation.definitionFit: Exaltedly means in an elated, joyful way, close in sense to happily or in high spirits.

clue.text: Single stormtrooper hiding fires

indicators.note: hiding says the letters sit concealed inside the words Single stormtrooper

explanation.surface: A lone stormtrooper is hiding and firing his blaster.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sINGLE Stormtrooper holds the word; 'fires' is a noun, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingle is a domestic fire on a hearth, the word surviving in inglenook.

clue.text: In … in … in case AT-AT's half destroyed

indicators.note: the second in tells us half the walker's name sits inside the conjunction

parts.note: lest means in case, as in 'lest we forget'

indicators.note: with half destroyed, only the first half of the name survives

explanation.surface: A stammering alarm about an AT-AT walker half blown up.
explanation.walkthrough: An AT-AT is the four-legged Imperial walker in The Empire Strikes Back; half of it gives AT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is 'in' is fashionable, the newest trend.

clue.text: Boba Fett, totally gutted, took to heart exploded moon quip

indicators.note: took to heart means placed the scrambled moon in the middle of what is left of the bounty hunter
totally gutted empties the whole name, keeping only its first and last letters
exploded says the letters of moon are blown apart and rearranged

explanation.surface: The bounty hunter, utterly crushed, broods over a joke about a blown-up moon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boba Fett' gutted as one name leaves B and T; MOON 'exploded' gives ONMO.
explanation.definitionFit: A bon mot, French for 'good word', is a clever, witty remark.

clue.text: … stretching Ben's followers?

definitions.meaning: making a supply last longer by using it sparingly
the singer of 'Stand By Me' is Ben ..., so the parts of the name after Ben follow it

explanation.walkthrough: Ben E. King was the American soul singer behind 'Stand By Me'; the '?' flags the wordplay sense of 'followers'.
explanation.definitionFit: To eke something out is to make it go further, so the participle means stretching it.

clue.text: Attack of the Clones' finale that follows acting getting a lot of sniggers

indicators.note: that follows places the final letter of Clones' after the word for acting

parts.note: an actor who is on is performing on stage

indicators.note: finale picks out the last letter of Clones'
a lot of means most but not all, so the end of the word for sniggers is dropped

parts.note: sniggers are laughter

explanation.surface: The final scene of Attack of the Clones got more giggles than gasps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a lot of' trims ER from LAUGHTER; 'Attack' is the definition, not part of the film title.
explanation.definitionFit: An onslaught is a fierce attack or assault.

clue.text: See 1
Fictional heroine adopting right fancy bit of hair

indicators.note: adopting means taking in, so the heroine's name takes the letter inside

parts.note: Tess of the d'Urbervilles is Thomas Hardy's heroine

explanation.surface: A storybook heroine takes on a rather elaborate lock of hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right fancy' reads like 'very fancy', but 'right' is just R.
explanation.definitionFit: A tress is a long lock of hair, often an ornamental curl.

clue.text: Unit of force on the rise, awakening

parts.note: N is the symbol for the newton, the unit of force
an ascent is a climb, being on the rise

explanation.surface: A Star Wars-ish thought: a measure of the Force growing as it awakens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the rise' is not a reversal signal: it gives ASCENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Nascent means just coming into existence, beginning to develop, like something stirring into life.

clue.text: I heard follower used to put dark side into orbit

definitions.text: used to put dark side into orbit

indicators.note: heard tells us to use a word that is pronounced like the letter

parts.note: the letter I is pronounced exactly like the organ of sight
a shadow is someone who follows another closely

explanation.surface: Someone claims to have heard a follower used to send the dark side into orbit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'orbit' is the eye socket, and 'dark side' the shading applied to the lid.
explanation.definitionFit: Make-up powder brushed on the lids darkens the area round the eye socket, which anatomists call the orbit.

clue.text: Team in Return of the Jedi sequel …

indicators.note: Return of says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the letters lie inside the words Jedi sequel, spanning the gap between them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A team appears in the follow-up to Return of the Jedi.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft named no word for the hidden step; 'in' is it. The film title is cut up: 'Return of' turns jEDI Sequel's EDIS round.
explanation.definitionFit: A side is a team in sport, such as a cricket or football eleven.

clue.text: Time to infiltrate military base. The quick way …

indicators.note: to infiltrate means to get inside, so the letter for time goes into the base

parts.note: Faslane is the Royal Navy base on the Clyde in Scotland, home of Britain's nuclear submarines

explanation.surface: It is time to break into an army base; this is the fastest way in.
explanation.walkthrough: Faslane is a Scottish naval base, home to Britain's Trident submarines.
explanation.definitionFit: The outside lane of a motorway is for overtaking, so it is where traffic travels fastest.

clue.text: … cuts through danger posed by alien among rubbish

indicators.note: among puts the danger and the alien inside the word for rubbish

parts.note: BS is slang shorthand for nonsense or rubbish
risk is a synonym of danger
ET is Spielberg's extraterrestrial

explanation.surface: Slicing through the peril an alien poses among the junk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cuts' is a noun: cuts of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Briskets are cuts of beef taken from the breast of the animal.

clue.text: … is in Cannes after opening of Phantom Menace

indicators.note: after places the French word behind the opening letter
opening of picks out the first letter of Phantom

parts.note: est is French for is, and Cannes is in France

explanation.surface: A film-festival nod: something is showing in Cannes after The Phantom Menace opens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Menace' is lifted out of the film title to be the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A pest is a nuisance or troublemaker, someone who is a menace to others.

clue.text: With Wicket's rear end and Ewok's head fur, it gets ruffled and more clumped

indicators.note: rear end asks for the last letter of Wicket
ruffled hair or fur is mussed up, so the letters are rearranged
head asks for the first letter of Ewok's

explanation.surface: Wicket the Ewok's backside and head fur get ruffled into clumps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruffled' rearranges T, E, FUR and IT. Wicket is the Ewok who befriends Leia in Return of the Jedi.
explanation.definitionFit: Tufty describes something growing in tufts, so the comparative means growing in more clumps.

clue.text: Aim ray to destroy force inside capital area

indicators.note: inside puts the letter for force within the scrambled letters
to destroy something is to wreck it, so the letters are broken and rearranged

parts.note: F is the symbol for force in physics

explanation.surface: Point the death ray to blast the Force out of the heart of a capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to destroy' scrambles AIM RAY to MAYAIR, with F 'inside'. MAYFAIR is a wealthy district of central London.
explanation.definitionFit: Mayfair is an upmarket district of London, the British capital.

clue.text: Time to go after space station in fighter craft

indicators.note: to go after places the word for time behind the station's name

parts.note: Mir was the Soviet and Russian space station
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Time for a fighter to chase down a space station, as in a Death Star assault.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dassault Mirage is a French jet fighter aircraft.

clue.text: Wiser way to hold saber-like weapon up

indicators.note: to hold means to contain, so the road abbreviation wraps the reversed sword

parts.note: Dr is the abbreviation for drive, a kind of road or way

indicators.note: up in a down clue says the sword is read from bottom to top

parts.note: an epee is a fencing sword, like the sabre

explanation.surface: The sage way is to raise your lightsaber-type blade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' signals a reversal because this is a down entry; 'saber' is the American spelling of sabre.
explanation.definitionFit: Deeper here means more profound in thought, hence showing more insight.

clue.text: Ford flying over red leader in criminal's fast vehicle

indicators.note: in places the car and the letter inside the word for a criminal

parts.note: a hood is a gangster or criminal

indicators.note: flying over in a down clue puts the car letter above the next piece

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car, so Ford gives T

indicators.note: leader takes the first letter of red

explanation.surface: Harrison Ford flies over Red Leader inside a crook's speedy ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ford' looks like Harrison Ford, but it is the Model T car; TR goes inside HOOD.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot rod is a car rebuilt and tuned for extra speed.

clue.text: Age 100 appearing in A New Hope

indicators.note: appearing in puts the Roman hundred inside the reworked word
New suggests a fresh version of the word Hope, its letters rearranged

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for 100

explanation.surface: A hundred turns up in the first Star Wars film, A New Hope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges HOPE as EPOH, with C inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch is a long era or period of history.

clue.text: Small parts in start of Revenge of the Sith edited, removing Hayden's first appearance

indicators.note: edited suggests the text has been cut and reworked into a new order
removing says a letter is taken out of the pool before it is rearranged
start of picks the first letter of Revenge
first appearance takes the opening letter of Hayden's

explanation.surface: Cutting Hayden Christensen out of Revenge of the Sith would leave it in tiny pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: R plus OFTHESITH loses one H 'removing' Hayden's first letter; 'edited' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortieth is one of forty equal parts of something, so these are small fractions.

clue.text: Actor Oscar is one where Alec is disheartened

parts.note: a is the indefinite article, meaning one

indicators.note: disheartened takes the heart out of Alec, leaving its outside letters

explanation.surface: An actor is the one where Alec Guinness has lost heart.
explanation.walkthrough: Alec Guinness played Obi-Wan Kenobi, but here 'Alec' just loses its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Oscar Isaac plays the pilot Poe Dameron in the newer Star Wars films.

clue.text: Sending up Palpatine initially to meet with ring Yoda organised

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of Palpatine
organised means arranged, so the letters are sorted into a new order

explanation.surface: The Emperor goes to a meeting that Yoda has arranged, ring and all.
explanation.definitionFit: To send up is to mock or satirise someone by imitation.

clue.text: Knowing Jawas prey endlessly

indicators.note: endlessly strips each word of both its end letters

explanation.surface: The Jawas know their prey well, without end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' leaves AWA and RE.
explanation.definitionFit: To be aware is to have knowledge or consciousness of something.

clue.text: Star where R2D2 runs amok with a few …

indicators.note: runs amok means goes wild, so the letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: read as R twice and D twice, the droid's name gives two Rs and two Ds

explanation.surface: R2-D2 goes berserk somewhere with a handful of companions.
explanation.walkthrough: The digits double the letters: R2 is RR, D2 is DD; 'runs amok' rearranges these with A FEW.
explanation.definitionFit: A red dwarf is a small, cool star, the commonest type in the galaxy.

clue.text: … men guarding prisoners, a squad, on board ship.

indicators.note: on board means inside a ship, so the squad sits within its abbreviation

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
a crew is a team or squad

explanation.surface: A detachment of guards with prisoners goes on board a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: SCREWS is British prison slang for warders.
explanation.definitionFit: Prison officers are called this in British slang.
